subskills.name: Offer a view tentatively
subskills.description: Put an opinion on the table in a way the listener may freely take or leave.

subskills.name: State a firm position
subskills.description: Say clearly where you stand and that you are prepared to defend it.

subskills.name: Hedge your certainty
subskills.description: Signal how sure you are, so a view sounds considered rather than absolute.

subskills.name: Align with a view
subskills.description: Show agreement or alliance with what someone has just said.

subskills.name: Disagree diplomatically
subskills.description: Disagree or resist a proposal while keeping the working relationship intact.

subskills.name: Concede and hold your ground
subskills.description: Grant a fair point without giving up your own position.

subskills.name: Decline without damage
subskills.description: Say no to a request or invitation and keep goodwill.

subskills.name: Soften a request
subskills.description: Ask for something, or for someone's view, in a low-pressure way.

subskills.name: Deliver unwelcome news
subskills.description: Prepare the listener before bad or awkward news.

subskills.name: Acknowledge another view
subskills.description: Show you understand someone's perspective before you respond to it.

subskills.name: Downplay and reassure
subskills.description: Lower the stakes of a mistake or a worry so the other person relaxes.

subskills.name: Thank and appreciate
subskills.description: Express gratitude strongly enough to build the relationship.

subskills.name: Take the floor
subskills.description: Enter the conversation or add a point without hijacking it.

subskills.name: Hold the floor
subskills.description: Keep your turn when someone tries to cut in.

subskills.name: Yield the floor
subskills.description: Hand the turn to someone and invite their view.

subskills.name: Interrupt politely
subskills.description: Break into someone else's turn with minimal friction.

subskills.name: Return to your point
subskills.description: Pick your own thread back up after an interruption or a detour.

subskills.name: Close your turn
subskills.description: Signal that you have finished speaking.

subskills.name: Ask for repetition or clarification
subskills.description: Get a missed or unclear point restated.

subskills.name: Check your understanding
subskills.description: Confirm you have understood, usually by paraphrase.

subskills.name: Rephrase yourself
subskills.description: Say the same thing differently when it did not land.

subskills.name: Correct a misreading
subskills.description: Fix a wrong impression of what you meant.

subskills.name: Buy thinking time
subskills.description: Keep the turn while you formulate an answer.

subskills.name: Recover from a slip
subskills.description: Retract or soften something that came out badly.

subskills.name: Open a topic together
subskills.description: Propose to work through a subject jointly.

subskills.name: Shift topic
subskills.description: Move to a new subject smoothly.

subskills.name: Return to an earlier topic
subskills.description: Bring a dropped subject back.

subskills.name: Take a tangent and come back
subskills.description: Flag a side remark, then return to the main line.

subskills.name: Close a topic
subskills.description: End or park a subject without friction.

subskills.name: Propose next steps
subskills.description: Turn discussion into action.

subskills.name: Weigh trade-offs
subskills.description: Present both sides of a decision.

subskills.name: Express skepticism
subskills.description: Voice doubt about a claim or plan without attacking its owner.

subskills.name: Express enthusiasm
subskills.description: Show real support for an idea.

subskills.name: Express mixed feelings
subskills.description: Say you are torn or undecided.

subskills.name: Raise a concern
subskills.description: Name a worry constructively.

subskills.name: Temper a claim
subskills.description: Pull back from an overstatement.

subskills.name: Lead with the point
subskills.description: Open with the conclusion instead of the build-up.

subskills.name: Summarize
subskills.description: Compress a discussion into one line.

subskills.name: Cut a story short
subskills.description: Skip the detail and give the outcome.

subskills.name: Signpost your structure
subskills.description: Tell the listener how long or how structured you will be.

subskills.name: Give the bottom line
subskills.description: State the core issue or net result.

subskills.name: Offer the short version
subskills.description: Give a compressed account on request.
